stem: Finished-batch EC is higher than expected. Source-water EC is also higher than normal, recipe additions were verified, and the meter passed verification. What is the best Technician I handoff?
choices: Document the verified high source baseline, final EC, recipe execution, and meter verification so the changed input can be evaluated
Conclude the fertilizer recipe is wrong
Delete the source-water reading because it complicates the record
rationale: The technician should preserve the evidence showing a changed source condition and verified execution rather than prematurely assigning a cause or making an unauthorized adjustment.
